prompt: Create ONE cinematic 16:9 frame, the PRESENT endpoint of an exact shoe-level match cut for our hand-painted Rafa and Luna film. Entire image is opaque GOUACHE and WATERCOLOR on warm paper, visible confident brush planes and restrained pencil contours; the shoe, fabric, room and light belong to the same tactile painted medium. No photograph/filter look, no 3D. REFERENCE1 is CS02G: preserve the classic construction of the inherited BLACK CANVAS HIGH-TOP CONVERSE RIGHT SHOE. Use its CENTER UPPER side elevation, the plain OUTER/LATERAL face with the small cream repair near the forefoot, not the inner ankle with circular badge. REFERENCE2 is D06 attic geometry and warm daylight; use its low angle. REFERENCE3 supplies Luna's PLAIN SOLID OLIVE cargo cloth only; do not copy sheet layout or show face. SINGLE CLOSE-UP: ONE RIGHT SHOE in strict OUTER side profile, toe points screen LEFT, heel screen RIGHT; lens axis perpendicular to shoe, ground-level 70mm perspective, absolutely no three-quarter angle. Shoe spans EXACTLY 45% of total image width, from x=27.5% at toe to x=72.5% at heel; bottom of sole lies flat horizontally at y=75% of image height. Foot is planted with toe and heel both touching floor, not lifting. Camera sees complete shoe unclipped, ankle/cargo cloth continues upward out of frame near x=67%. Plain olive loose cargo hem ends just above shoe collar so silhouette remains recognizable. The sole is narrow flat ivory vulcanized rubber, toe cap ivory, laces off-white and normally tied, silver eyelets. Controlled worn black canvas and mildly aged rubber. One SMALL rectangular cream stitched repair about 2cm wide on OUTER forefoot canvas just above rubber, as reference1; not on ankle or rubber. OUTER ankle is plain black: NO circular star badge, no ventilation holes invented, no lettering. The room is the D06 attic with pale timber floorboards, warm light from LEFT, vague painted open trunk/window/brick hints softly simplified behind. Keep enough visible floor below the shoe (25% of frame). Absolutely one shoe/one lower leg, no second shoe, no hands, no faces, no skateboard, no collage, no comparison panels, no labels, no text, no visual portal. This is a clean restrained transition anchor, ready for an exactly registered second image.
